pic.text: You are wrongfully detained without any reason. Which right protects you from such arbitrary detention?
pic.explanation: This right ensures that no one can be arbitrarily detained without just cause.

pic.text: You want to express your opinion about a social issue without fear. Which right allows you this freedom?
pic.explanation: This right allows individuals to express their opinions freely.

pic.text: You are facing discrimination at work due to your caste. Which right protects you from such discrimination?
pic.explanation: This right ensures protection against discrimination based on religion, race, caste, sex, or place of birth.

pic.text: You want to move freely within the country without any restrictions. Which right allows this freedom?
pic.explanation: This right ensures the freedom to move throughout the country.

pic.text: You are concerned about the environment. Which directive principle aims to protect the environment?
pic.explanation: This directive principle aims at protecting the environment.

pic.text: You want to start a business but are facing barriers due to government policies. Which directive principle aims to promote economic development?
pic.explanation: This directive principle encourages economic development.

pic.text: Your child is working in a hazardous job. Which article protects your child from such exploitation?
pic.explanation: This provision prohibits employment of children below 14 in hazardous jobs.

pic.text: You are denied a government job because of your caste. Which right protects you from such discrimination?
pic.explanation: Ensures equality of opportunity in public employment.

pic.text: You want to be involved in local governance. Which part of the Constitution provides for Panchayats and Municipalities?
pic.explanation: Includes provisions for local self-governance through Panchayats and Municipalities.

pic.text: You want to peacefully protest against a government decision. Which right allows you this freedom?
pic.explanation: Allows individuals to assemble peaceably and express their views.

pic.text: You are a student and want to publish an article criticizing a government policy. Which right protects your freedom of speech?
pic.explanation: Allows you to express your opinions through writing.

pic.text: You are planning to leave the country to study abroad. Which right protects your freedom to travel?
pic.explanation: Guarantees the freedom to move abroad.

pic.text: You want to start a business but are unable to get a loan due to financial constraints. Which directive principle aims to secure a living wage for all workers?
pic.explanation: Aims at securing a living wage for workers.

pic.text: You are concerned about child labor in your area. Which directive principle addresses the welfare of children?
pic.explanation: Aims at providing free and compulsory education to children and protection from child labor.
